text: A cooking range rarely gives you the quick heating performance you need on some occasions, like when the kitchen suddenly gets slammed with orders. You need something that has your back in those emergency busy moments. Equipment that gives you that quick heating you need to keep up with the pace of orders. The Combisteel Induction Cooking Top 2000W gives you fast, reliable heat when you need to get pans hot quickly. Since it’s an induction cooking top, it uses magnetic energy to quickly heat up the pan with minimum energy loss because there is no direct or indirect flame involved. It has digital controls that allow you to adjust the power from 500W to 2000W according to how much heat your dish needs. The controls are so easy to operate, you don’t need to give your team member special training to operate this cooking top. They can learn how to use it in a matter of minutes. This energy-efficient equipment is only 30cm wide, which gives a very small footprint, meaning it can fit easily anywhere on your workbench. The cooking top surface is made up of tough and durable stainless-steel which rarely needs any cleaning during service. It runs on a standard 230V electricity socket without any special wiring adjustments. All you have to do is plug it into the socket, and you’re good to go. This unit is a simple way to add extra cooking power whenever the kitchen gets busy.

In a commercial kitchen, it’s always the full-size cooking range that handles the majority of the cooking tasks. In that situation, you can’t rely on your traditional range; you need something that gives you quick and reliable heating performance. Connect it to the 230V socket and start cooking without needing any special installation. It’s a must-have no matter what scale your kitchen is operating at.

The quality of wok-style cooking depends entirely on that fierce, instant kiss of heat that scorches and awakens the ingredients before they can soften or produce steam. You can’t do wok-style cooking using gentle heat, which is why using the wrong equipment can change the whole character of the dish. The Combisteel Induction Wok Cooking Top gives you the fierce, instant heat you need to keep wok cooking fast, hot, and full of flavour. It can deliver up to 3500W of power, which can be easily adjusted through a press-button digital control system. That power output is strong enough to give wok cooking the fast, responsive heat it actually needs. Regardless of its high-power output, this electric wok hob runs on a standard 230V electricity socket, which makes it a highly energy efficient equipment. This wok hob has a very small footprint, which gives you the luxury of placing it anywhere you want on your counter or workbench. It’s also very lightweight (6Kg), which allows you to carry, move, and reposition it easily whenever you need to adjust your counter layout. Even though it has a very small footprint and little weight, it’s highly durable and built to handle the demands of a busy commercial kitchen.

With this equipment, you get the speed and the contact heat that lets the food cook properly instead of stewing. A cooking top that finally respects the way wok cooking is meant to work.

What are you going to do if your dedicated cooking range is busy with a big order and you need to cook something that comes in unexpectedly? Your kitchen needs high-performance cooking power when the number of orders is increasing at a rapid rate. But what if you don’t have any floor space to spare for a cooking range that does the job? The entire induction range is built from sturdy stainless steel to stand strong through demanding commercial service, while its smooth surface makes cleaning quick and effortless for your team. When two cooking zones stop being enough, adding more cooking capacity becomes necessary to keep up with growing customer demand and to stay ahead of your competitors. Once a dish is prepared, it’s not always served right away to the customer’s table, and there are many reasons for that. Maybe the rest of the order isn’t ready, or maybe all the tables are booked, and the kitchen needs somewhere to hold finished dishes until the table is ready. These situations call for dedicated storage that holds your cooked food and maintains the hot temperature and freshness of the dishes. That’s a job the Combisteel 600 Heated Cupboard Pass-Through 1200 was designed to handle by holding and protecting your newly cooked dishes at the right steaming temperature. It has one spacious shelf and two doors, and behind those two doors it keeps the dishes warm and moist until the remaining order for one specific table is ready to be served. With a heating element of 2.4kW, it keeps food at serving temperature without drying it out or overcooking it further. This 77Kg heated pass-through cabinet is only around 1200mm wide, which is a suitable size for kitchens of almost any scale. This matters a lot in small kitchens where every inch of floor space needs to be used wisely. It also has a depth of 600mm, which means you get generous internal space to hold multiple prepared dishes at once without needing a larger footprint. It runs on a 230V supply, giving you a straightforward electrical requirement for commercial kitchen use.

In busy commercial kitchens, a heated pass-through cupboard that has only room for a handful of plates at a time forces you to keep finished dishes on the worktop while waiting for the rest of the order. This wait, even if it’s for some minutes, can compromise the quality of the dish your chef worked so hard to craft and will eventually lead to customer dissatisfaction and negative feedback about your food. The Combisteel 600 Heated Cupboard Pass-Through 1600 was designed to give you the extra room that solves the storage problem and ensures your customers always experience the dish as your chef intended it to be served. With a width of 1600mm, this heat pass cupboard can hold noticeably more dishes at once. The depth of 600mm allows you to store a full table’s worth of food at a safe, hot temperature to prevent it from cooling down or even spoiling. Its 2.4kW heating helps maintain a consistent serving temperature, keeping prepared dishes hot and ready to serve. Despite being heavy-duty equipment, all you need is a standard 230V electrical power supply to do the job you need it to do. If you want all your customers to always experience every dish just as fresh and appetising as when it left the kitchen, this is a must-have piece of equipment for every commercial kitchen or restaurant.

Everyone thinks the most important task in a kitchen is crafting a dish that shows a chef's expertise and is loved by customers, but no one talks about what happens once the dish is prepared. The Combisteel 700 Heated Cupboard Pass-Through 1200 is the answer you were looking for. If you've ever watched a queue build up while your fryer is having a hard time bringing the oil back to the frying temperature, you're no stranger to the situation when the service falls apart because of that delay. The Combisteel base 700 gas fryer is built to stop that from happening to you, to protect your sales, workflow, and reputation. It gives you a capacity of a generous 15 litres with a 15kW gas burner, which means when you drop a full load of frozen chips or fries in the oil, the heat comes back quickly, getting the next batch ready before the customers' expectations. This fryer comes with two frying baskets, which lets you run two orders next to each other instead of waiting for one while the other is in the frying process. The built-in thermostat gives you perfect temperature, allowing you to lower the temperature for foods that need careful slow frying and raise the temperature to 180°C, ideal for deep frying. At just 400mm wide, it fits neatly into compact kitchens without wasting valuable workspace. Since it runs on gas, you don't have to worry about putting an extra strain on your bills during a busy service. So, if you want a fryer that keeps up with demand and speeds up service without any delay, this fryer is the only option you need to have right now in your kitchen.

Every customer comes to you for the unique flavour of what they order. No one likes the fries that taste like fish, and fish that taste like fries. And this transfer of flavours can kill the mood, and you'll end up losing a returning customer. Now, you can understand how costly this little and insignificant mistake can be for your brand. The Combisteel BASE 700 Gas Fryer 2x15L is designed to make sure this incident never happens to you. This equipment gives you two separate 15 litres oil tanks, which means you can fry fish in one tank and fries in the other, and there will be no exchange of flavours between the two items. One of the most powerful features about this unit is that each tank has its own 15kW burner. This means if you need to slow fry one item and quick-fry the other one, you can do that by controlling the temperature of each tank individually. So, you will never have customers complaining about late serving, and you can keep every order leaving your kitchen at the quality your customers expect. So, when the orders are piling up and one tank is not enough, this is the upgrade your kitchen needs to keep service fast and flavours perfectly separated.

Frying food in volume is something that every restaurant needs to do efficiently if they don't want to compromise on their service quality and speed. Let's say the orders are stacking up, and all you have is a small oil tank for frying. This is a serious problem because you'll end up frying in small batches, and due to continuous frying cycles, the oil never holds the heat to the right frying temperature. The Combisteel BASE 700 Electric Fryer 18L solves that problem. It gives you a generous 18-litre tank, which allows you to drop bigger batches at once and still get an even, reliable result every time. The 14kW electric element heats the oil steadily and evenly, which matters when you need to serve your customers with perfectly cooked, crispy food even during the busiest hours of service. This electric fryer comes with two baskets that let you handle two separate orders effortlessly. The thermostat gives you precise temperature control, which becomes extremely useful when you have different foods that need to fry at different temperatures. With its compact 400mm width, it is ideal for busy kitchens that need high performance without sacrificing valuable workspace.

Some kitchens don't need a big double fryer, but going for a small fryer means settling for something slow and underpowered, resulting in longer wait times, smaller batches, and frustrated customers. That's where the Combisteel BASE 700 Electric Fryer 10L gives you the perfect balance between capacity, power, and kitchen space. It gives you a decent capacity of 10 litres in a slim frame of 400mm width, which makes it an ideal option for kitchens short on space. The powerful 9kW electric heating element brings up the oil temperature fast, which saves you from long waiting for the temperature to reach the required level for the next batch. It comes with a wide basket so you can drop a moderate size batch. The thermostat gives you complete temperature control, whether you are frying something light or something heavy. Since it's an electric unit, you don't have to worry about managing the burner or the gas line, which makes it easy to install. So, if you run a kitchen where space is genuinely tight and want a reliable fryer, this is the one you need to have in your kitchen as soon as possible.

Once your kitchen gets busy enough, one tank stops being a fryer and starts being a bottleneck, with everything queuing behind a single tank of oil. The BASE 700 Electric Fryer 2x18L takes that pressure off by giving you two full 18-litre tanks, each with its own 14kW element, so you can fry two items at once without one waiting on the other. Keeping the tanks separate means your fish stays out of your chips and each one cooks in oil that is not carrying yesterday's flavours around. Four baskets across the two wells let you keep several orders moving in parallel, which is exactly what you need when the tickets are stacking up faster than you can clear them. The even electric heat holds steady across both tanks, so a full drop of frozen food does not send the temperature crashing and leave you with a limp, greasy result. The most useful attribute of this fryer is that it gives you independent temperature control for both oil tanks, which means you can fry something at a low temperature in one tank while keeping the other tank running at a higher temperature for items that need a faster, crispier finish.

Frying two completely different menu items in the same tank is always going to end up in a disaster because the flavours start bleeding into each other and neither dish tastes the way it needs to. The Combisteel BASE 700 Electric Fryer 2x10L fixes that issue once and for all. It gives you a compact frame with two separate 10 litres oil tanks so that you can fry your onions on one side and the fish on the other without worrying about the flavours leaking into each other. Each tank has its own heating element of 7.5kW which brings up the oil temperature quickly and maintains it there, allowing you to drop the next batch right after the previous order is served. The twin fryer also comes with a thermostat, a precise temperature control system which allows you to change the temperature of both tanks individually. So, if you want a fryer that is compact, reliable, and keeps every menu item tasting exactly the way it should, this is the upgrade you need.

If frying food is your most-selling menu category, then peace and silence are something you'll never experience. In those everyday busy hours of service, you can't risk your business reputation by relying on a small fryer that cannot keep up with the pace of the orders coming in.
